messages:
anya: Quick alignment - LumenHealth prefetch pilot target next week. Need a concise list of launch gates from runtime/infra/security/SRE. Can we make a short binary checklist?

sam: Runtime items: 1) p95 <= 120ms on our 2k seq synthetic during ramp. 2) Canary path for new batching kernel + compare token output for 500 sample requests. 3) Telemetry hook for KV cache warmup.

mike: Infra: guaranteed burst capacity (2x for 48h) + autoscale with 2m cooldown. Also need explicit quota for warmup memory (KV cache +1.2x). We'll need customer CIDR + staging contact to configure peering.

jess: Security: KMS usage validated (customer-managed preferred). No plaintext secrets in manifests. 90d audit logs required. Need a short threat model + signoff before keys go live.

lee: SRE: Rollback automation required. Trigger conditions: error rate >0.5% sustained for 10m OR p95 latency >30% above baseline for 10m. Also require alerting and runbook link in the launch doc.

tara: Product ask: a one-paragraph customer-facing launch note with expected latency, cost delta, and any functionality differences. Customer wants cost guidance for quantized vs float paths.

sam: I can produce cost delta table. Early estimate: q4_0 profile ~30-40% token compute reduction, varies by sequence length. Will run sims and post CSV.

mike: Infra action: I'll provision NAT egress IPs and prewarm nodes once sam gives expected CPU/GPU footprint. Also will create the VPC peering request — need CIDR and contact.

jess: If customer-managed keys, we need a PoP (proof of possession) handshake and a short KMS rotation plan doc. Tara, can you get the contact?

tara: Yup, I'll share contact and their security lead by EOD. They prefer customer-managed keys.

deploy-bot: Heads-up: reserve window 2026-04-03 02:00 UTC for canary. Please attach preflight checks to rollout.

anya: Proposed binary launch gate checklist for the doc: [Telemetry dashboards wired] [KMS signoff + rotation doc] [Burst pool + quotas provisioned] [Canary + output parity check] [Rollback playbook + alerts] [Customer contact for peering/keys]. Owners?: sam/runtime, mike/infra, jess/security, lee/SRE, tara/product.

sam: I take telemetry + cost sims + parity check. ETA: cost sims in 36h, basic dashboard panels in 48h.

mike: I'll do burst pool + NAT egress + peering request. Provisioning 6-12h after sam's sizing.

jess: Rotation doc + signoff checklist draft in 24h. Will need one short review slot after peering is up.

lee: Rollback runbook draft in 24h, alert rules + escalation in 40h.

tara: Contact inbound by EOD. I'll draft the customer-facing note once sam posts cost numbers.

anya: Awesome. I'll convert checklist into a launch doc and share a link here. If any blocker appears (KMS, peering, or perf regression) escalate to #release-war-room immediately. :thumbsup:
